top.title: SpaceX completes its acquisition of Cursor
top.summary: AI coding startup Cursor is now officially part of SpaceX after the acquisition closed.
top.why: Treat AI coding platforms as increasingly strategic infrastructure dependencies and monitor whether SpaceX integration changes Cursor's hosting, data-use or enterprise roadmap.

top.title: Anthropic explains how Claude's new watermarks will work
top.summary: Anthropic has shared more details about Claude's watermarking, including how the markers may withstand editing and how the approach affects generated code.
top.why: Revisit provenance and compliance requirements for Claude-generated content before assuming that edits or code transformations remove the ability to identify its origin.

top.title: Cloudflare adds agent tracing with billable spans from October
top.summary: Cloudflare's agent tracing adds spans for agent invocations, model calls, tool runs and approvals, with turn-by-turn session replay; traces can be truncated, payload defaults vary by framework, and every span becomes a billable event on October 1, 2026.
top.why: Instrument a representative workload and set payload and retention policies before adopting it, because incomplete traces can limit debugging while span volume will directly affect observability cost.
